tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Current, right-now status of one monitored service (e.g. 'Slack', 'AWS', 'Google Workspace'): live status, active issue, subservice breakdown, and a link to details. Accepts a service name or id; fuzzy matching is applied. For historical reliability (uptime % over past weeks), use get_service_uptime instead.

tools.name: get_overall_status
tools.description: Overall health summary of all cloud services monitored by NTS Status Central: counts by status, which services currently have issues, and how fresh the data is. Use this first to answer 'is anything down right now?'.

tools.name: get_service_uptime
tools.description: Historical reliability of one monitored service: weighted uptime percentage over the trailing N days (max 90), plus counts of outage/degraded/maintenance days and the current run of consecutive operational days. For the live right-now status, use check_service_status instead.

query.description: Service name or id, e.g. 'slack' or 'aws'.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1-90). Defaults to 90.

tools.name: list_current_incidents
tools.description: All services with an ongoing issue right now (outage, degraded performance, or scheduled maintenance), including when each started and the latest note. Empty list means everything monitored is operational.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all services monitored by NTS Status Central, optionally filtered by current status (operational, degraded, outage, maintenance) or category (e.g. 'Cloud Services', 'Security', 'Communication').

status.description: Only include services currently in this status.

category.description: Only include services in this category (case-insensitive substring).
